Professional appearance, reliability, and the ability to maintain composure during long or complex shoots. Basic understanding of advertising, fashion, or visual branding is beneficial. Previous experience in modeling, promotion, or brand representation is an advantage but not strictly required. Fluency in English; Dutch language skills are a plus. Ability to work on-site in Amsterdam and maintain a flexible schedule aligned with studio and client bookings.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Work with Us. Change the World. At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us. Job Description Project Director – Major Rail Projects Location: UK-wide, with flexibility to be based from one of AECOM’s major UK offices The Opportunity AECOM is seeking an exceptional Project Director to lead the successful delivery of major, complex rail infrastructure projects and programmes across the UK&I and Europe. This is a high-profile leadership position for an experienced rail professional who can take overall accountability for the delivery of large-scale projects, from positioning, winning, mobilisation and development through design, construction and commissioning. The successful candidate will operate at senior client and stakeholder level, lead multidisciplinary teams, manage major commercial and delivery risks, and create the conditions for safe, predictable and high-performing project delivery. AECOM is at the forefront of delivering some of the most ambitious infrastructure programmes, bringing together expertise across project and programme management, engineering, planning, commercial management, digital and advisory services. The role offers the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of major rail investments and help shape the future of the region’s transport infrastructure. What You’ll Do As Project Director, you will have end-to-end leadership and accountability for major rail projects, acting as the senior point of contact for clients, partners and key stakeholders. Your responsibilities will include: Provide strategic leadership and overall direction to major rail projects and programmes. Assist in the positioning and winning of major complex infrastructure projects, specifically major rail programs. Establish and maintain a high-performing project organisation, bringing together multidisciplinary engineering, project management, commercial, planning, environmental and construction teams. Own project delivery strategy, governance, performance and outcomes. Lead project mobilisation, implementation and transition through the project lifecycle. Maintain strong relationships with senior client representatives, sponsors, operators, infrastructure managers, contractors, suppliers and other stakeholders. Establish clear project objectives, performance measures, governance structures and delivery plans. Lead the management of programme, cost, schedule, risk, quality, safety and change. Provide robust challenge and assurance to ensure projects remain deliverable, commercially sound and aligned with client objectives. Drive effective decision-making across complex interfaces and competing stakeholder priorities. Lead the resolution of significant technical, commercial, contractual and delivery issues. Ensure appropriate application of project controls, reporting, assurance and governance. Promote a strong culture of safety, quality, sustainability and technical excellence. Develop and mentor senior project and programme managers, creating a strong succession pipeline within the rail business. Support AECOM's growth strategy by identifying opportunities, developing client relationships and contributing to bids and major pursuits. Represent AECOM at senior industry, client and stakeholder forums. Champion innovation, digital delivery, modern methods of working and sustainable infrastructure solutions. Essential Significant senior project or programme leadership experience within the rail sector. Proven experience leading large-scale, complex infrastructure projects , ideally with significant capital value, multiple interfaces and challenging stakeholder environments. Demonstrable responsibility for project outcomes across cost, schedule, risk, quality and delivery. Experience working with major rail clients, infrastructure owners, operators, government bodies, delivery partners and/or Tier 1 contractors. Strong understanding of the rail environment and its governance, assurance, safety and regulatory requirements. Experience leading large multidisciplinary teams and complex supply-chain relationships. Strong commercial awareness and experience managing contractual, commercial and financial issues. Excellent communication, influencing and stakeholder-management skills at Board and senior executive level. Experience spanning both client-side and consultancy/delivery environments. Formal project or programme management qualification such as APM, PMI or equivalent. Develop and mentor the next generation of infrastructure leaders. Build a long-term leadership career within a global infrastructure business. We believe diverse, inclusive teams deliver better outcomes for our clients, communities and the infrastructure we create. We welcome applications from candidates from all backgrounds and are committed to providing a fair and inclusive recruitment process. At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. About AECOM AECOM is the world’s trusted infrastructure consulting firm, delivering professional services throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. On projects spanning transportation, buildings, water, new energy and the environment, our public- and private-sector clients trust us to solve their most complex challenges. Je vertaalt technische input naar 2D- en 3D-modellen, voert constructieberekeningen uit (waaronder FEM) en adviseert over de meest efficiënte en veilige oplossingen. De kern van je werk ligt bij constructieberekeningen, detaillering en BIM-integratie in projecten voor bovenregionale netten, waarmee je direct bijdraagt aan een toekomstbestendige energievoorziening. Je gaat aan de slag bij een technisch advies- en ingenieursbureau in de energietechniek, met een duidelijke focus op hoogspanningslijnen en energie-infrastructuur voor Nederlandse netbeheerders. Binnen de gespecialiseerde business unit voor hoogspanningslijnen richt het bureau zich op het ontwerpen, berekenen en optimaliseren van staalconstructies voor bovenregionale netten. Je werkt nauw samen met engineers, werkvoorbereiding en projectleiding aan constructieve oplossingen die de energietransitie in Nederland ondersteunen en de betrouwbaarheid van het hoogspanningsnet vergroten. Wat ga je doen? Tekenen en modelleren van staalconstructies voor hoogspanningslijnen in 2D en 3D met focus op kwaliteit, detail en toepasbaarheid; Opstellen van ontwerp- en detailberekeningen voor staalbouwconstructies en deze inhoudelijk controleren, waarbij de FEM-methode wordt toegepast; Adviseren over technische oplossingen richting engineering en uitvoering binnen projecten in de energietechniek; Verzamelen van technische input en vertalen van deze gegevens naar eenduidige specificaties en werktekeningen; Signaleren van technische knelpunten in een vroeg stadium en integraal meedenken over verbeteringen in ontwerp en uitvoering; Zorgen voor afstemming met interne teams (engineering, werkvoorbereiding, projectleiding) en externe stakeholders gedurende het hele traject. Wat neem je mee? Beschikken over een afgeronde opleiding richting Werktuigbouwkunde of gelijkwaardig; Affiniteit met de staalbouw of elektrotechniek; Hebben van ervaring met AutoCAD 2D én bij voorkeur met 3D-software zoals SolidWorks, Solid Edge, Revit of gelijkwaardig is een pré; Vertrouwd zijn met normeringen (NEN/ISO), ontwerpvoorschriften en constructieberekeningen is een pré; Beheersen van de Nederlandse én Engelse taal goed in woord en geschrift; Gestructureerd en accuraat werken en technische keuzes helder kunnen onderbouwen.
